name: atlassian-twg-cli
description:
Cursor knows your codebase. The reasons behind the code are spread across Jira work items, Confluence specs, pull requests, incidents, Loom videos and Slack threads. Teamwork Graph CLI (twg) gives Cursor's agent one command-line interface to that context.

- One graph across your tools. Teamwork Graph maps the work items, docs, PRs, people and decisions across Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Jira Service Management, Loom, Goals, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive and Salesforce.
- Built for agents. Cursor runs twg commands to get structured JSON, pulling in only the context the task needs. It can read the work item before writing code, check the spec before opening a PR, or find who owns a service before changing it.
- Easy to script. Output is structured JSON, so you can script it, pipe it, or use it in CI.
- Runs as you. Commands use your Atlassian sign-in, so Cursor can only access what you have permission to see.

How it works:
1. Install the plugin.
2. Run /twg-setup to install twg and sign in with your Atlassian account.
3. Ask in plain English. Cursor picks the right twg command and runs it.

Try it:
- "Read <insert name> project and its linked spec, then implement it"
- "Who owns this service, and what's changed on it recently?"
- "Draft a Jira work item from this PR and link it to the epic"
